title: zanthoxylum trijugum
intro: Zanthoxylum trijugum, commonly known as the Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, providing health benefits such as pain relief and improved digestion. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum trijugum include analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
